title: This didn't last very long.
text: This didn't last very long.. Started to fall apart within a month or so - I should have returned it, but I tossed it and bought a different one.  Quality is not good and it is a bit small for an entry door.

product_metadata.title: Wrought Iron Rubber Door Mat, Fleur De Lis - 18 Inch Width, 30 Inch Length - Durable, Easy to Clean & Decorative Outdoor Welcome Mats - Heavy Duty for All Weather - Doormat Traps Dirt, & Mud
features: Rubber Welcome Mat: Help your guests feel welcome before they step inside with these classic doormats. The Wrought Iron Outdoor Rubber Mat is built for all seasons anywhere, and comes in plenty of unique styles.
Material: Heavy duty construction made with anti-skid rubber.
Features: Keep dirt outside and brighten any entry way with this mat. Measures 18” x 30”.
Care Instructions: Easy to clean; just shake, sweep or rinse with the garden hose.
